title: Hotel sheets
text: Hotel sheets. The  sheets are pretty not the best but the price is good and that is what i was looking for. Nice and soft. They could use a bit of better detail work and i will not know how well they hold up but that is ok with me. If i get a couple of years out of them that is ok also. I would buy these again even with the uneven detailing. i like the colors you are able to chose from.
